info.title: Argo CD API (baton-argo-cd connector surface)
info.description: Subset of the Argo CD REST API that the baton-argo-cd connector's pkg/client package calls. Scope is limited to the connector's request sites, not the full Argo CD API. Response schemas include only the fields the connector's Go structs (pkg/client/models.go, client.go, accounts.go) declare via json tags; shapes and nullability are settled against Argo CD's published swagger. The connector also calls the Kubernetes API directly (ConfigMaps argocd-cm/argocd-rbac-cm, Secret argocd-secret) via client-go; those operations are Kubernetes API calls, not Argo CD REST calls, and are intentionally not represented here.

servers.description: Admin-configured Argo CD server base URL (connector's --api-url flag / apiUrl config field).

post.summary: Log in and obtain a JWT session token
post.description: Called by Client.ensureAuthenticated before any other request. Exempted from the bearer-auth requirement below (authRoundTripper skips auth for this path) since it is how the token is obtained in the first place.

get.summary: Get a single Argo CD local account
get.description: Client.GetAccount. A 404 response is treated by the connector as ErrAccountNotFound.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Argo CD local account name (Go argument: username).

delete.summary: Revoke a single API token issued to an account
delete.description: Client.revokeAccountToken (called from RevokeAccountTokens). A 404 response is treated by the connector as already-revoked (not an error).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Argo CD local account name (Go argument: username).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Token ID (Go argument: tokenID, sourced from Account.Tokens[].ID).

404.description: Token already revoked / not found; treated by the connector as success.

put.description: Client.UpdateUserPassword, called both directly (account creation flow) and via Client.RotateAccountPassword. The request authenticates the change with the connector's own current admin password as currentPassword.

200.description: Password updated. Success response is an empty body with 200 status.

bearerAuth.description: Client.setAuthHeader sends 'Authorization: Bearer <session token>' on every request except /api/v1/session, using the token obtained from POST /api/v1/session (see authRoundTripper.RoundTrip in client.go).

SessionCreateRequest.description: Fields the connector sends (client.go loginData). Argo CD's SessionCreateRequest additionally accepts a 'token' field for token-based login; the connector never uses it and it is omitted here (spec scope is connector scope).

SessionResponse.description: Client.ensureAuthenticated decodes this into an anonymous struct with only 'token'.

token.description: JWT session token. The connector treats an empty/absent token as an authentication failure.

AccountsList.description: Client.GetAccounts decodes this into an anonymous struct with only 'items'.

tokens.description: Omitted by the Go struct's 'omitempty' when empty; the connector's RevokeAccountTokens loop tolerates a nil slice.

AccountToken.description: pkg/client/models.go AccountToken struct. Argo CD's accountToken definition also has an 'expiresAt' integer field, which the connector's struct does not declare and therefore does not read; omitted here per spec scope.

EmptyResponse.description: The connector does not decode a body for this response (UpdateUserPassword and revokeAccountToken only check the HTTP status). Argo CD's swagger declares an empty object for both (accountEmptyResponse / accountUpdatePasswordResponse).

ErrorBody.description: The connector does not deserialize error bodies into a struct; httpStatusError reads the raw response body as text and embeds it in the wrapped error message. Argo CD's swagger describes error responses with this shape (runtimeError); included for documentation purposes only, not because the connector parses it.
